versions.subject: New Rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\dsacls.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: "DSACLS.EXE"
selection_flag:
    CommandLine|contains: ' /G '
selection_permissions:
    CommandLine|contains: # Add more permissions as you see fit in yout env
        - 'GR'
        - 'GE'
        - 'GW'
        - 'GA'
        - 'WP'
        - 'WD'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\dsacls.exe" OR OriginalFileName="DSACLS.EXE" CommandLine="* /G *" CommandLine IN ("*GR*", "*GE*", "*GW*", "*GA*", "*WP*", "*WD*")
